title: Los escenarios de Aurelià y de Dirección
description: src/boss-stages.ts, docs/places/palace-zones.md § The bosses' stages. Aurelià's gym and Direcció's meeting room built for their fights, as the Queen's stage is: each with its short entrance, and a lower, more frontal camera. Run it with --gpu.

steps.caption: Aurelià's entrance: the gym dark, only her plum in the high windows; the first row of tubes catches over the lanes' start
Row by row the tubes come on down the lanes towards his dais, the camera gliding low along them
The school bell: the scoreboard lights, the spotlight slams on, and he is there from below; his name
The camera pulls back over Gerard's and Aitor's shoulders into the fight; the bars open

steps.eval: navigator.getGamepads = () => []; window.ui = window.gerard.battleUI; window.ready = () => ui.fight && ui.fight.phase === 'player' && !ui.fight.busy && !document.querySelector('#battle[data-entering]') && document.activeElement?.matches('.command-trigger'); window.closeUp = (id, d) => { const p = window.gerard.game.fighterAt(id); window.gerard.game.frame({ x: p.x, y: p.y + (d || 4.2) * .28, z: p.z }, d || 4.2); };

steps.caption: La pista: lanes painted from the party to his marble dais, the columns with her laurel of gum, the wall bars, the timeline, the scoreboard running his lap, the plint and the mats; a lower, more frontal camera
Aurelià before his dais, the blackboard and his desk behind him
Dirección's entrance: the meeting room dark, the blinds shut, a line of morning round them
Bay by bay the blinds open: stripes of light fall across the carpet and the long table
The three lamps come on and the stamp comes down on the minutes: CONSTA EN ACTA; the three from below, their name
The camera pulls back over Gerard's and Aitor's shoulders into the fight; the bars open

steps.caption: La sala de juntas: the windows behind them in stripes, the long table with three empty chairs and three lamps, the book of minutes, the school's seal with her gum, the clock stopped at nine, binders down the sides
The table behind them: the lamps, the folders, the book of minutes stamped in her pink ink
